thread:
lina_sales: Quick heads-up  Orbit POC needs a final prompt stocktake + success criteria alignment. Can we get a tidy baseline prompt list and pass/fail evals by EOD Tuesday? Their answers to security/pricing block the kickoff. @omar_se @ben_pm

omar_se: Ack. I can condense into prompt families. Prefer 6-8 canonical families (happy/edge/attack) rather than everything.

lina_sales: 6-8 families sounds right. Orbit prioritizes: PII redaction, intent classification, and short reply generation. Also they want latency target ~200ms p50 and cost guardrails.

ben_pm: Proposed success thresholds: entity F1 >= 0.92, intent acc >= 0.94, generation relevance >= 0.88 (human-rated). Latency p95 < 500ms on Dedicated; cost target < $0.003/token. Thoughts?

sofia_re: I'll build the eval harness. Need 50 sanitized examples per family. Can we pull from their redacted CSV (120 rows) or synthesize to reach counts?

lina_sales: I'll upload a sanitized subset to Drive. Use synthesis to augment if needed.

omar_se: Draft baseline families (pushed as a snippet):

1) REDACT_PII: find & redact names, emails
2) INTENT_CLASS: map to 12 intents
3) SMART_REPLY_SHORT: 1-2 sentence professional reply
4) RANK_CANDIDATES: rank options by relevance
5) STRUCT_FIELD_EXTRACT: date, amount, account_id
6) ADVERSARIAL_NEG: negation/edge cases

ben_pm: Pricing note: Dedicated = lower token price + SLO-backed p95; Hosted can hit latency with prefix caching but has higher cost. I'll draft a short pricing appendix.

anne_sre: Security asks from Orbit: SOC2 requirement, retention windows, and KMS for keys. Need confirmation whether logs can be disabled for PII flows and default retention. I'll loop in Legal for standard language.

lina_sales: Flag blockers by tomorrow noon: dataset gaps, final success thresholds, security gating items. If any of these slip we delay kickoff.

sofia_re: Eval plan: automated metrics (precision/recall/F1), generation metrics (BLEU/ROUGE) + 20 human review samples for relevance. I'll post the initial dashboard link when ready.

omar_se: Please pin canonical SMART_REPLY_SHORT prompt for reproducibility. Example template I'll add to the repo: "Given the user message and context, generate a concise professional reply in \u003c=2 sentences. Do not invent facts."

devops_bot: deploy:eval-harness v0.3 started by @sofia_re  ETA ~20m. Logs: https://ci.internal/reports/1951234567

lina_sales: Thanks team  I'll consolidate actions and send Orbit a recap after blockers are collected. :thumbsup:

ben_pm: Sharing pricing appendix by EOD.

sofia_re: Starting sanitization now; will need 2 clarification examples from Orbit for ambiguous intents.

omar_se: Pushing canonical prompt templates to repo and tagging in this thread.
